diagnosis: Secondary peripheral atypical cartilaginous tumour / chondrosarcoma, grade 1 (ACT/CS1), resection specimen
legend: Secondary peripheral ACT/CS1 arising juxtaposed to a pre-existing osteochondroma. The size of the cartilaginous cap, which should be measured perpendicular to the tidemark, exceeds 2 cm.

diagnosis: Secondary peripheral atypical cartilaginous tumour / chondrosarcoma, grade 1 (ACT/CS1)
legend: A lobular hyaline cartilaginous tumour is seen with nodular extension into the surrounding soft tissues.

diagnosis: Secondary peripheral atypical cartilaginous tumour / chondrosarcoma, grade 1 (ACT/CS1)
legend: Tumours show moderate cellularity and an abundance of hyaline cartilaginous matrix. Areas of hypertrophic differentiation and calcification (right) can be seen.

diagnosis: Secondary peripheral atypical cartilaginous tumour / chondrosarcoma, grade 1 (ACT/CS1), resection specimen
